confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and comparable-city calibration; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. Meal and coffee anchors are moderately reliable. Hotel and hostel prices vary widely by district and season, so accommodation anchors are less certain. Beer and derived alcohol prices are the weakest, given heavy alcohol taxation in Jordan. Cocktail was set at about 1.6 times the beer anchor and wine glass at about 1.3 times, because direct knowledge of local bar and restaurant alcohol prices is weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: No supplied comparable is in Jordan. Amman was placed between the South and Southeast Asian comparables and Tel Aviv: food and coffee above Colombo and Phnom Penh but far below Tel Aviv; dorm and private hostel slightly above Colombo and Phnom Penh; basic and three-star hotels near Colombo with a modest uplift.
